SUBARU-WITCH_TEA_PARTY_EVENT.title: The Witches' Tea Party
SUBARU-WITCH_TEA_PARTY_EVENT.pages.INITI:
Your mind drifts, and when you come to, your feet are already standing in a hidden little world. The moss is warm, and the air smells of black tea.

A [sine]Witch[/sine] sits at the far end of a long table. The cups are already laid out, as if she has been waiting a long while. She lifts her eyes and invites you to join their tea party.
SUBARU-WITCH_TEA_PARTY_EVENT.pages.ACCEP: You sit down. Your mind drifts, and you find yourself back where you started.
SUBARU-WITCH_TEA_PARTY_EVENT.pages.THINK: You stand by the long table for a while, but in the end you never sit down.
SUBARU-WITCH_CONTRACT_EVENT.title: The Witch's Contract
SUBARU-WITCH_CONTRACT_EVENT.pages.INITIA:
She raises her right hand, palm up, and holds it between you.

"When you run into an obstacle you cannot overcome, I will worry over it with you. If your sins are about to crush you, I will hold you up."

She pauses, as if remembering something.

"Of course — this will reach across the realm of the dead."
SUBARU-WITCH_CONTRACT_EVENT.pages.ASK.de:
"You will die. Then you will come back. From now on, I can see that."

Her tone is as light as if she were discussing the weather.

"Seeing means bearing it with you. So every time you come back, I am a little closer to you. Not such a bad thing, is it?"
SUBARU-WITCH_CONTRACT_EVENT.pages.SIGNED: The instant your palm touches hers, it feels as if nothing happened at all.
SUBARU-WITCH_CONTRACT_EVENT.pages.REFUSE: You pull your hand back. She does not try to stop you.
"...I see." She draws her hand back, smiles, and says no more.

SUBARU-ALICE_AND_THORN_KING_EVENT.title: Alice and the King of Thorns
In the night, a green-haired man stands alone on the hill, staring into the empty dark. As you come closer, a sharp pain pierces your chest — unseen thorns are winding around your heart.

The man does not turn around. He only says, quietly: "...You are not my star. But you can see the stars too, can't you."
Gain [gold]Thorn Crown[/gold] and add the curse [red]Injury[/red] to your deck.
"Wouldn't counting the stars in the night sky be more comforting than staring into the dark?"

You stand with him for a while. The pain of the thorns does not fade, but it seems... to stop tightening.

(The thorn is still there, but it remembers your voice.)
He reaches out to you. You know the thorns will pierce you, but you also see the loneliness that has not left his eyes in three hundred years.
Gain [gold]Thorn Crown[/gold] and add the curse [red]Injury[/red] to your deck.

"I permit it. Everything that has to do with you."

Thorns wrap around your wrist, like a ring, and like a chain.

You do not look back. Behind you the thorns rustle in the dark, like a very soft sigh.

(You hear him say: "...As expected. I have only one star.")
